doc.brief: The QStackedWidget class provides a stack of widgets where only one widget is visible at a time.
doc.index_brief: Stack of widgets where only one widget is visible at a time

QStackedWidget(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a QStackedWidget with the given *parent*.

QWidget * currentWidget() const.brief: Returns the current widget, or `nullptr` if there are no child widgets.

QWidget * widget(int index) const.brief: Returns the widget at the given *index*, or `nullptr` if there is no such widget.

int addWidget(QWidget *widget).brief: Appends the given *widget* to the [QStackedWidget](xref:qt:QStackedWidget) and returns the index position.

int count() const.brief: This property holds the number of widgets contained by this stacked widget

int currentIndex() const.brief: This property holds the index position of the widget that is visible

int indexOf(const QWidget *widget) const.brief: Returns the index of the given *widget*, or -1 if the given *widget* is not a child of the [QStackedWidget](xref:qt:QStackedWidget).

int insertWidget(int index, QWidget *wid.brief: Inserts the given *widget* at the given *index* in the [QStackedWidget](xref:qt:QStackedWidget).

void currentChanged(int index).brief: This signal is emitted whenever the current widget changes.

void removeWidget(QWidget *widget).brief: Removes *widget* from the [QStackedWidget](xref:qt:QStackedWidget). i.e., *widget* is *not* deleted but simply removed from the stacked layout, causing it to be hidden.

void setCurrentIndex(int index).brief: This property holds the index position of the widget that is visible

void setCurrentWidget(QWidget *widget).brief: Sets the current widget to be the specified *widget*.

void widgetAdded(int index).brief: This signal is emitted whenever a widget is added or inserted.

void widgetRemoved(int index).brief: This signal is emitted whenever a widget is removed.

count.brief: The number of widgets contained by this stacked widget

currentIndex.brief: The index position of the widget that is visible
